verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Feature Gates (feature flags) that toggle product behavior in real time without redeploying, and SDKs evaluate them via checkGate, so the core flag-gated rollout exists. A community user also reports adopting it as a LaunchDarkly alternative. However, the evidence never documents targeting rules by user properties, cohorts, or percentage rollouts for gates; the experiment group-splitting evidence covers a different capability and does not transfer. Missing for 10: documented targeting by user properties, cohort-based targeting, percentage rollout controls for gates, independent hands-on corroboration of targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts

citations.quote: Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.
How to call checkGate in Statsig client and server SDKs to evaluate a feature gate
